messages.content: Help me add a 'click' event listener to a button element 'myButton' that triggers a function named 'handleButtonClick' and stops the event from propagating by setting options's stopProgation to true?

function.name: buttonAddClickHandler
function.description: This function attaches a click event listener to a specified button element with options to control event flow and behavior. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

element.description: The button element to which the event listener will be added. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

callback.description: The function to be called when the button is clicked. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

options.description: An options object to specify characteristics about the event listener, such as stopping propagation. Optional parameter. Default to be empty dictionary This is JavaScript dict type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning: We need to call the function buttonAddClickHandler with element 'myButton', callback 'handleButtonClick', options with stopPropagation true. The tool expects strings for element and callback. Options is optional string representation of JS dict. So we need to pass options: '{"stopPropagation":true}'. Also note that the property name is stopProgation? The user typed stopProgation but likely meant stopPropagation. The tool expects options string. We'll pass correct property name. Use the function.
